components.purpose: Title and one-line intro at the top of the page, with no image or buttons. Its guidance covers a plain heading with subheading and description, and rules out Hero for this case.
The plans as cards: each plan's name, monthly price, highlights and a CTA button. Its guidance says it is for plans side by side with a button per plan.

The full comparison grid, feature by feature across plans. I chose it over PricingTable because its rows are editable content items, and PricingTable needs a hand-built JSON structure I'd have to guess.
The billing FAQs at the bottom of the page. It has no agent guidance on the instance, so this choice is based on its name alone.
